I will do it mostly the way I have done in recent years, because on 3 mu I cannot afford to experiment too much. I have farmed here in Quzhou for 50 years, so I start from what works on our land and then adjust a little for cost and water. Wheat and maize are still my main food and cash support, so I will keep 2 mu in the wheat-maize rotation, then leave 1 mu for cotton. I do use improved or hybrid seed now if I see people nearby get a steadier stand and better yield. For fertilizer, I would rather spend a bit more than let the crop go hungry, especially for wheat and maize, because one bad season hurts more than a few extra kilos of fertilizer. Since I have well irrigation, I will not let the crop wait too long for water at key times. On my small area, I can manage the field myself, so I will keep tillage and spraying simple and do the work on time.
